name: Espressif IoT Development Framework (ESP-IDF)

entry_points.template:
# Baseline ESP-IDF configuration marker for {project_name}
CONFIG_IDF_TARGET="esp32"

ci_workflow:
name: {project_name} CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: espressif/idf:v5.4
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Verify Strict LF
        run: |
          if grep -r $'\r' --exclude-dir=.git .; then
            echo "CRLF line endings detected!"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Build ESP-IDF Firmware
        run: |
          if [ -n "${IDF_PATH:-}" ] && [ -f "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" ]; then
            . "$IDF_PATH/export.sh"
          fi
          idf.py build
      - name: Run ESP-IDF Tests
        run: |
          if [ -n "${IDF_PATH:-}" ] && [ -f "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" ]; then
            . "$IDF_PATH/export.sh"
          fi
          idf.py test
